fields.description: Eggs, warm bread and a good reason to take your time.
Vegetables, a little seafood and something for the middle of the table.
Fish from the harbour and the slow work of the kitchen.
A proper lunch, whether you have ten minutes or an hour.
Fruit, cream and something still warm from the oven.
Coffee, house sodas and a few things to linger over.
A short stack, crisp at the edges, with warm maple syrup.
fields.ingredients: buttermilk, brown butter, maple, sea salt

fields.description: Two eggs nestled into greens, finished with feta and toasted dukkah.
Picked harbour crab on thick toast with a squeeze of lemon.
Soft eggs and mushrooms from the pan, with toast for the juices.
Slow oats with pears poached until tender.
White beans in a rich tomato sauce, toast on the side.
Sweet leeks from the grill, romesco and a little sharp vinegar.
Twice-cooked potatoes with smoked paprika and house plant aioli.
Creamy burrata with bright citrus and toasted pistachio.
Sardines cooked quickly over the grill, lemon at the table.
Sweet roast carrots with tahini and toasted cumin.
Warm white beans whipped with garlic, rosemary and olive oil.
The harbour in a bowl: fish, mussels and a saffron broth.
fields.ingredients: mussels, hake, fennel, saffron broth, aioli

fields.description: Slow lamb, warm chickpeas and enough harissa to notice.
Fresh ribbons of pasta with mushrooms, thyme and parmesan.
A golden half chicken over beans and greens.
fields.ingredients: chicken, butter beans, cavolo nero, lemon

fields.description: The catch from the quay, cooked simply with brown butter.
fields.ingredients: market fish, new potatoes, capers, brown butter

fields.description: Roast aubergine over warm lentils, with tomato and tahini.
Beef braised until tender, with sweet onions and potato.
Slow rice, sweet squash and crisp sage leaves.
Warm pork, sharp fennel and a generous spoon of salsa verde.
fields.ingredients: slow pork, salsa verde, pickled fennel, ciabatta

fields.description: Warm grains, roast squash and the good pickles from the kitchen.
Crisp hake in ciabatta, with cabbage, lemon and olive oil.
fields.ingredients: hake, cabbage, lemon, olive oil, ciabatta

fields.description: Sweet squash, hummus and peppery leaves on sourdough.
Warm chicken and rice with cool cucumber and ginger dressing.
A crisp toastie with cheddar, ripe tomato and mustard.
Creamy rice with bay leaf and a spoon of blackberry compote.
A soft slice of olive oil cake, with citrus and crème fraîche.
Dark chocolate, a little cream and a few flakes of sea salt.
Quince poached slowly with vanilla, served with oat cream.
Sharp sea buckthorn, ginger and a squeeze of lime.
A short espresso over tonic and ice, with orange peel.
A double espresso with smooth steamed milk.
A changing coffee, brewed fresh through the morning.
Fresh mint leaves, hot water and a quiet few minutes.
A house apple shrub, long with soda and rosemary.
A long table, five plates and a few good bottles. Join Ines for a Saturday supper from the harbour.
Oysters from the coast, cold glasses and warm bread. Come by on Friday evening.
Meet the growers behind a few of our favourite bottles, with small plates from the kitchen.
A slow Sunday lunch with roast chicken, potatoes and the whole table together.

seo.description: An all-day canteen by the harbour in Bellport.
Good food, warm bread and a place at the table.
Breakfast, small plates, mains and something sweet.
The Halfmoon menu, from breakfast to dinner.
Meet the people behind Halfmoon Canteen.
Supper clubs, oyster nights and long Sunday lunches.
A look around Halfmoon Canteen.
Find a place at the table at Halfmoon Canteen.
Write to us, call or find us on Quay Street.
